headline.purpose: The single <h1> per screen, from PageHeader.

body.purpose: Default. Table cells and descriptive copy.

shadows.name: tinted-button-halo
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons only. The system's one ambient lift.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour/opacity change on hover and focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one 'go' action per surface. Ledger Olive with a faint tinted halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.5rem; padding:0.5rem 1rem; border:none; border-radius:0.5rem; background:var(--color-primary); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgb(57 98 0 / 0.2), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(57 98 0 / 0.2); transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The companion action. White card fill with a ruled border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.5rem; padding:0.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:0.5rem; background:var(--color-card); color:var(--color-foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.5rem; padding:0.5rem 1rem; border:none; border-radius:0.5rem; background:var(--color-destructive); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity:0.9; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring); } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary actions; text only, turning olive on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.5rem; padding:0.5rem 1rem; border:none; border-radius:0.5rem; background:transparent; color:var(--color-muted-foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-primary); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Field Grey fill with a ruled border; focus is a ring, not a border change.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.375rem; font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--color-foreground); } .ds-field { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0.625rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:0.5rem; background:var(--color-input); color:var(--color-foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:0.875rem; } .ds-field:focus { outline:none; border-color:transparent; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring); } .ds-field:disabled { opacity:0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White panel on warm paper; flat, ruled border, 1rem radius.
components.html:
Onboarding gate

Body copy sits directly on the card surface.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--color-card); border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:1rem; padding:1.25rem; color:var(--color-foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans); } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 1rem; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-foreground); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Warm off-white rail; the active item is a Pale Sprout pill with near-black bold text.
components.html: DashboardParticipants
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.25rem; padding:1rem; background:var(--color-sidebar); font-family:var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.75rem; padding:0.625rem 1.5rem; border-radius:9999px; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--color-secondary); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:var(--color-sidebar-accent); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background:var(--color-primary-fixed); color:var(--color-on-primary-fixed); font-weight:700; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status as colour-plus-text, never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.25rem; padding:0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius:9999px; font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-badge-warning { background:var(--color-warning-container); color:var(--color-on-warning-container); } .ds-badge-error { background:var(--color-error-container); color:var(--color-on-error-container); } .ds-badge-access { background:var(--color-accessible-container); color:var(--color-on-accessible-container); }

narrative.overview: ODIP is a working record before it is a product. It is used by office coordinators running the operational day of Australian NDIS disability services. Someone sits in this system for hours. The design's job is to make a long day of dense, consequential work feel calm and legible rather than clinical or flattering. The palette is earthy and deliberately un-glossy: a deep olive primary on a warm off-white background, never pure white as the page, never pure black as text. Surfaces separate by warm-grey tonal stepping rather than by shadow. Density is a feature. Compliance is core behaviour, not an add-on.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, earthy, low-gloss; depth by tonal stepping, not by shadow
High information density with a strict, repeated row-and-column rhythm
Colour used semantically and sparingly — a ledger's colours mean something
Compliance state (alerts, countdowns, audit) is first-class, never decorative
44px minimum touch targets throughout; built for shared kiosks and long sessions

rules.name: The Semantic Colour Rule
rules.body: A colour never carries meaning twice. If a screen is reaching for a colour that isn't on the semantic list, it is reaching for the wrong thing.

rules.name: The Warm Base Rule
rules.body: The page is never #ffffff and text is never #000000. Warm off-white and near-black are what separate ODIP from a generic Material dashboard.

rules.name: The One Heading Rule
rules.body: Exactly one <h1> per screen, and it comes from PageHeader. A screen that needs two titles is two screens.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Never add vertical padding to a table row to make it breathe. If a table is too tall, the answer is fewer columns, not more air.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If a panel needs a drop shadow to be visible, its background is wrong.

dos: Do express depth with warm tonal surfaces and reserve shadows for primary buttons
Do keep 44px minimum touch targets on every actionable element
Do render one <h1> per screen via PageHeader
Do use Button for every action rather than hand-rolled button classes
Do keep compliance state, alerts and countdowns visually equal to ordinary data
Do cap long free-text cells (Provenance) and lead rows with the primary action
donts: Don't hardcode hex, rgb() or any literal colour — always var(--color-*) or a Button variant
Don't use pure #ffffff as a page background or pure #000000 as text
Don't invent a colour outside the semantic list to express a new state
Don't hand-roll button styling; the shared Button owns padding, radius and focus
Don't add a second page heading, or shrink table text to save width
Don't restyle a single module more heavily than any other
